name: Spicy Tuna Salad Lettuce Wraps with Avocado, Green Onions & Jalapeño

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 ½ jalapeño peppers
3 avocados
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place half in a large bowl. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
Drain tuna, add to the bowl with the green onions, and flake with a fork.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 (170 g) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.primary_message: Add mayo, chili-garlic sauce, soy sauce, oil, and salt to the bowl. Stir to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup mayonnaise
3 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice jalapeño peppers into rings; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Season with salt.
To serve, pile lettuce leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates; fill with avocado and tuna salad. Top with reserved green onions and jalapeño. Enjoy!
